pr_title: Fix online play subscreens not pushing player loaders when starting gameplay
pr_body:
Closes #12797 
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/12790.

This simply regressed in #12538 due to the `CreateGameplayScreen()` overrides not creating a player loader, but instead return the player and push it immediately.
pr_comments: Added test coverage on this. @smoogipoo requesting your review.

issue_context.title: Starting gameplay in multiplayer/playlists pushes player screen without a loader
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** Whenever I'm pressing the start button in playlist lobby, there is an empty Lazer background screen appearing for ~1 second instead of a loading screen.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:**  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=srZG_8TDi0o

**osu!lazer version:**  2021.514.0

**Logs:** 

[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6475773/runtime.log)
[updater.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6475774/updater.log)
[database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6475775/database.log)
[network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6475776/network.log)
[performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6475777/performance.log)
[performance-audio.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6475778/performance-audio.log)
[performance-draw.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6475779/performance-draw.log)
[performance-update.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/6475780/performance-update.log)
comments: Looks to be an oversight from #12538, `CreateGameplayScreen()` should return a player loader with the player inside rather than just the player directly, will get this one.

review_comments:
I've generally tried to avoid this to keep logic without these special cases. `TestSceneMultiplayer` can be used to test this, which already has examples.

But I don't think this is too bad... I think... So I'll go with it for now.
